nodes.name: Spiritual Focus
nodes.description: Restores 5 mana every 5 seconds per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Flash of Light and Holy Light by 14%-70%.' DEPARTURE - there are no cast times in this engine, so there is no pushback to suffer or reduce. The talent exists so a healer keeps casting under pressure; delivered as mana regeneration, which is what keeps a healer casting here. Kept from the outgoing tree. mp5 is FLAT and lands on the attribute.

nodes.name: Seals of the Pure
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Seal of Righteousness by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the damage done by your Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Vengeance and Seal of Corruption and their Judgement effects by 3%-15%.' Only Seal of Righteousness exists here. Built at the real 3% per rank. ability_<id>_potency scales the ability's own stat_mods, which is the right key for a seal. The outgoing version was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: Healing Light
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim across all three real spells: 'Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light and the effectiveness of Holy Shock spells by 4%/8%/12%.' USES _healing, NOT _damage - a heal's per-ability key is ability_<id>_healing, and 18 talents across four classes shipped silently dead using _damage on a heal. The outgoing version covered two of the three at 8% per rank.

nodes.name: Aura Mastery
nodes.description: Reduces magic damage taken by 4%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Causes your Concentration Aura to make all affected targets immune to Silence and Interrupt effects and improve the effect of all other auras by 100%. Lasts 6 sec.' DEPARTURE - there is no aura system, no silence and no interrupt key. What survives is magical protection for the paladin. Kept from the outgoing tree. magic_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and NEGATIVE reduces, which is the opposite sign to its meaning inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Divine Intellect
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your total Intellect by 2%-10%.' Built verbatim and kept from the outgoing tree. intellect_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS, read off the `bonuses` dict and divided by 100 - the probe finds no literal read site for it and it is nonetheless live. This node feeds Holy Guidance at tier 4.

nodes.name: Illumination
nodes.description: Your critical heals have a 20% chance per rank to restore 150 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 20%-100% chance to gain mana equal to 30% of the base cost of the spell.' Built as the real mechanic with the real chance curve. Mana-as-a-percentage-of-the-spell's-cost is not available to a proc payload - grant_resource takes a FLAT amount, with no pct_max - so 150 is a fixed return. on_crit is not restricted to heals by an ability_filter because listing the three heals would exclude Holy Shock's damage mode, which the real talent also counts. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Unyielding Faith
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of Stun effects against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the duration of all Fear and Disorient effects by 15%/30%.' DEPARTURE - there is no Fear and no Disorient; is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate, so the reduction applies to that instead. stun_duration_reduction_pct is a FRACTION, not points, and it floors a stun at 1 turn so it can shorten but never negate.

nodes.name: Improved Lay on Hands
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Lay on Hands by 3 turns per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Grants the target of your Lay on Hands spell 10%/20% reduced physical damage taken for 15 sec. In addition, the cooldown for your Lay on Hands spell is reduced by 2/4 min.' The cooldown half is built - ability_<id>_cooldown is FLAT turns. The damage-reduction half cannot be built: a talent effect can never reach an ally, and nothing lets a talent attach a rider to an ability's cast. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Improved Concentration Aura
nodes.description: Reduces magic damage taken by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 5%-15% and while any Aura is active reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effect used against you by 50%.' DEPARTURE - no aura system, no silence, no interrupt. Stacks with Aura Mastery one row above, as the real pair does through the aura it improves. The outgoing version was stun_duration_reduction_pct, which is Unyielding Faith's job in the real tree.

nodes.name: Pure of Heart
nodes.description: Increases all healing you receive by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the duration of Curse, Disease and Poison effects by 15%/30%.' DEPARTURE - nothing modifies an incoming effect's duration by dispel school; dispel_type marks what CAN be removed and no key shortens it. The talent is about shrugging off what lands on you, delivered as healing received. The outgoing version was magic_damage_taken_pct, duplicating two other nodes in the same tree.

nodes.name: Divine Favor
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 5%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.' DEPARTURE - there is no guaranteed-crit key and no ability to unlock, and nothing consumes a buff on use. Delivered as a flat crit chance. Kept from the outgoing tree. The real talent requires Illumination and is Holy Shock's prerequisite; connected_to keeps it upstream of Holy Shock below. crit_chance_spell is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Improved Blessing of Wisdom
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 10%/20%.'

nodes.name: Sanctified Light
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Holy Light and Holy Shock by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim across both real spells: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy Light and Holy Shock spells by 2%/4%/6%.' The outgoing version was 4% per rank on Holy Light alone. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Blessed Hands
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse by 10 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the mana cost of Hand of Freedom, Hand of Sacrifice and Hand of Salvation by 15%/30%...' DEPARTURE - none of the three Hand spells exist here. Cleanse is the paladin's remaining utility spell, so the cost cut lands there. Kept from the outgoing tree. ability_<id>_cost is FLAT.

nodes.name: Purifying Power
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Consecration by 5% per rank and the cooldown of your Exorcism by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse, Purify and Consecration spells by 5%/10% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 16%/33%.' Purify and Holy Wrath do not exist; the rest is real. _cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION. The outgoing version was Holy Shock damage, which is nothing to do with this talent.

nodes.name: Holy Power
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%-5%.' Built verbatim - scoping crit to one school is not available (crit_chance_spell covers all spells), and every Paladin spell here is Holy anyway, so the distinction is academic for this class. The outgoing version was per-ability healing, duplicating Healing Light.

nodes.name: Light's Grace
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Holy Light by 5 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Gives your Holy Light spell a 33%-100% chance to reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light spell by 0.5 sec.' DEPARTURE - there are no cast times. The talent exists to make Holy Light cheaper to chain; delivered as mana cost. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Sacred Cleansing
nodes.description: Your Cleanse has a 30% chance per rank to shield the target against magic for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Your Cleanse spell has a 10%/20%/30% chance to increase the target's resistance to Disease, Magic and Poison by 30% for 10 sec.' Built as the real mechanic with the real chance and the real 10 seconds (3 turns). Per-school dispel resistances do not exist, so it becomes magic damage reduction. MIND THE SIGN AND UNIT: inside a status effect magic_damage_taken_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (so -10.0 is -10%), the opposite convention to the same key as a talent effect, where it is a fraction. on_target is False because a talent-sourced effect cannot be aimed at the Cleanse's target. The outgoing version was flat healing_done.

nodes.name: Holy Shock
nodes.description: Teaches Holy Shock, striking an enemy or mending an ally with raw Light.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for paladin_holy_shock, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Divine Favor, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Blessed Life
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'All attacks against you have a 4%/7%/10% chance to cause half damage.' DEPARTURE - a proc on on_damage_taken fires AFTER the hit resolves and cannot reduce the damage that triggered it, so a chance-to-halve cannot be built. Delivered as a smaller permanent reduction, which is the same expected value shape without the variance. damage_taken_pct is read RAW on both sides.

nodes.name: Holy Guidance
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 4% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases your spell power by 4%-20% of your total Intellect.' This is a real STAT CONVERSION - spell_power is a valid target and intellect a valid source. THE UNIT IS A TRAP: the key is read as `gained = source * pct` (character.py:1551), so it is a RAW MULTIPLIER and not a percentage. Authoring 20 would have granted twenty times the paladin's Intellect; measured live, 50 gave +2400 spell power off 48 Intellect. 0.04 per rank reaches the real 20%. Pairs with Divine Intellect two tiers up, exactly as the real tree intends.

nodes.name: Divine Illumination
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of all your abilities by 10%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Reduces the mana cost of all spells by 50% for 15 sec.' DEPARTURE - there is no ability to unlock and no way to grant a temporary global cost reduction from a talent. Delivered as a permanent but much smaller cut. MIND THE KEY: all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION, and it FLIPS to percentage POINTS inside a status effect - audit_talents has caught that flip being got wrong in this project before. The outgoing version was a proc.

nodes.name: Infusion of Light
nodes.description: Your Holy Shock critical hits increase the critical chance of your next heals by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Holy Shock critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Flash of Light by 0.75/1.5 sec or increase the critical chance of your next Holy Light by 10%/20%.' The SECOND clause is real and buildable, so that is the one built, at the real 20%; the cast-time clause has nothing to act on. ability_filter on Holy Shock is exact. 'Next spell' becomes a 2-turn window, since nothing consumes a buff on use. The real talent requires Holy Shock, reproduced. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Judgements of the Pure
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Judgement by 5% per rank, and casting it quickens you by 15% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built with BOTH halves - a node may carry effects AND a proc: 'Increases the damage done by your Seal and Judgement spells by 5%-25%, and your Judgement spells increase your casting and melee haste by 15% for 1 min.' The real 5% per rank and the real 15% haste. 1 minute becomes 3 turns. The Seal half is covered by Seals of the Pure at tier 0. The outgoing version was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: Enlightened Judgements
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the range of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom spells by 10/30 yards and increases your chance to hit by 2%/4%.' The hit half is built verbatim - range does not exist. hit_rating is PERCENTAGE POINTS and is NOT a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET, so it can be granted directly like this but never converted into. The outgoing version was Judgement damage, which is Judgements of the Pure's job.

nodes.name: Beacon of Light
nodes.description: Your heals spill over, mending your neediest ally as well.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone: 'The target becomes a Beacon of Light... Any heals you cast on party or raid members will also heal the Beacon for the same amount.' DEPARTURE - a talent cannot designate an ally as a target, and there is no heal-mirroring mechanic. smart_heal is the engine's real 'heal whoever needs it most' payload, so the capstone becomes a second, automatic heal on every cast - which is the real talent's EFFECT (one cast, two targets healed) reached from the other direction. icd 1 keeps it to once a turn. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Light's Fury
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
